proposedDemandScenarioRows.title: Urban Lifestyle Conversion
proposedDemandScenarioRows.demandScenarioDescription: Independent urban boutique or lifestyle hotel converting into Tribute Portfolio while preserving local character, design narrative, and guest-facing identity—adding Marriott commercial systems and Bonvoy participation rather than a prototype-led reflag.
proposedDemandScenarioRows.ownerImplication: Underwrite conversion PIP scope, design latitude within collection standards, and whether urban ADR and operating complexity support a lifestyle collection affiliation—not select-service economics.
proposedDemandScenarioRows.demandLogic: Consumer-site urban examples (e.g., Hotel Rumbao in Old San Juan, Humano Lima on the Malecón) show Tribute anchoring city lifestyle assets; development captures describe an operating model for independent hotels seeking Marriott affiliation.
proposedDemandScenarioRows.sourceBasis: Tribute consumer site (recF0qS9JIZjM3qza) property map + Marriott development capture (recSLu3N7s84rIKS6); property URLs SJUTX, LIMTX as illustrative examples—not performance claims.
propertyExamples: Hotel Rumbao, a Tribute Portfolio Hotel (SJUTX)
Humano, Lima, a Tribute Portfolio Hotel (LIMTX)
proposedDemandScenarioRows.founderReviewStatus: AI-drafted from official-source metadata; Pending founder review; Not company-validated; Not Marriott-validated

proposedDemandScenarioRows.title: Resort / Leisure Repositioning
proposedDemandScenarioRows.demandScenarioDescription: Resort or leisure-led independent asset repositioning under Tribute—Caribbean, Riviera Maya, or other leisure markets where owners want collection affiliation with resort-scale guest experience and Marriott network access.
proposedDemandScenarioRows.ownerImplication: Model seasonal demand, resort operating complexity, all-inclusive or F&B scope, and PIP investment before assuming Bonvoy distribution lift clears franchise and loyalty fees.
proposedDemandScenarioRows.demandLogic: Consumer-site resort listings (Crystal Cove Barbados, future Casa Nizuc listing) illustrate leisure-footprint use cases within the collection; directional only—no occupancy or RevPAR claims.
proposedDemandScenarioRows.sourceBasis: Tribute consumer site (recF0qS9JIZjM3qza) + property URLs BGITY, CUNAN; aligns with existing partial row title 'Resort & leisure conversion' pending owner-implication backfill.

Casa Nizuc, a Tribute Portfolio Resort (CUNAN — future listing example)

proposedDemandScenarioRows.title: Independent Hotel Seeking Marriott Distribution
proposedDemandScenarioRows.demandScenarioDescription: Owner-operated independent hotel that wants Bonvoy participation, global distribution, and Marriott sales/commercial support while keeping an independent sense of place and local programming latitude.
proposedDemandScenarioRows.ownerImplication: Compare fee stack, loyalty contribution assumptions, and retained design/programming flexibility against harder reflag options—Tribute fits when independence and character are strategic, not when a prototype select-service reflag is the goal.
proposedDemandScenarioRows.demandLogic: Brand page capture emphasizes 'Stay independent' and unique personalities; development sources frame Tribute as an operating model for independent hotels with lender-confidence context—founder-reviewed directional use case, not a performance guarantee.
proposedDemandScenarioRows.sourceBasis: Marriott brand page capture (recNvITV5HzuQburM) + development portfolio capture (recSLu3N7s84rIKS6); Bonvoy page (recBonvoy secondary context only).
proposedDemandScenarioRows.founderReviewStatus: AI-drafted from official-source metadata; Pending founder review; Not company-validated; Not Marriott-validated

proposedDemandScenarioRows.title: Mixed-Use Or Destination-Led Hospitality
proposedDemandScenarioRows.demandScenarioDescription: Hospitality component within mixed-use or destination-led development where Tribute adds lifestyle collection positioning and Marriott ecosystem access without forcing a standardized chain prototype.
proposedDemandScenarioRows.ownerImplication: Validate that destination draw, non-room revenue, and guest-experience investment support collection standards—weak fit when the asset is primarily economy transient or highway-oriented.
proposedDemandScenarioRows.demandLogic: Development captures reference independent-hotel operating model and lender-confidence framing; approved positioning treats conversion/repositioning as a core Tribute use case when local character and experience investment are central to the deal thesis.
proposedDemandScenarioRows.sourceBasis: Marriott development home + portfolio captures (recZmeduOoM1PZEpT, recSLu3N7s84rIKS6) + founder-reviewed positioning from required-section source-capture package.

proposedDemandScenarioRows.title: Secondary Market Lifestyle Upgrade
proposedDemandScenarioRows.demandScenarioDescription: Secondary or regional-market independent asset upgrading to lifestyle collection affiliation when local ADR depth and demand profile support design, F&B, and service investment through conversion and QA cycles.
proposedDemandScenarioRows.ownerImplication: Stress-test ADR ceiling, staffing model, and market demand depth—Tribute is a lifestyle/independent-character play, not an economy or limited-service highway reflag.
proposedDemandScenarioRows.demandLogic: Approved positioning emphasizes boutique, lifestyle, and resort assets where local character supports premium conversion; weaker where market ADR cannot support full-service or resort operating complexity.
proposedDemandScenarioRows.sourceBasis: Founder-reviewed AI draft from brand-explorer-required-section-source-capture-package + consumer/development source set; no market-statistics claims.

proposedDemandScenarioRows.title: Operator-Led Reflag Or Repositioning
proposedDemandScenarioRows.demandScenarioDescription: Third-party operator-led conversion or reflag where the owner wants Marriott soft-collection affiliation, with the operator executing PIP, opening support, and ongoing QA rhythm under collection standards.
proposedDemandScenarioRows.ownerImplication: Align operator capability with collection design, F&B, and service expectations; confirm franchise and loyalty economics in the pro forma after fees—not just brand logo lift.
proposedDemandScenarioRows.demandLogic: FDD and development sources describe franchise operating model context; Tribute's collection posture suits operator-led repositioning when independent identity and Bonvoy access are both deal requirements.
proposedDemandScenarioRows.sourceBasis: 2026 Tribute FDD capture (recjVfKnl9q18MO5w — secondary factual) + development captures; directional franchise-model context only.

proposedDemandScenarioRows.title: Economy / Limited-Service Reflag
proposedDemandScenarioRows.demandScenarioDescription: Prototype select-service, economy, or highway-oriented limited-service reflag seeking lowest-cost affiliation—outside Tribute's independent lifestyle and resort collection positioning.
proposedDemandScenarioRows.ownerImplication: Route to Marriott select-service or limited-service flags if economics drive the decision; do not force Tribute when operating model, design scope, and guest experience cannot support collection standards.
proposedDemandScenarioRows.demandLogic: Approved positioning explicitly contrasts Tribute with prototype-led select-service reflags; collection fit requires design, F&B, and experience investment—not economy transient posture.
proposedDemandScenarioRows.sourceBasis: Founder-reviewed positioning from display-content-completion + required-section source-capture package; negative scenario for owner clarity (parity with reference brands' 'not a fit' row).
